subject: contract
title: A field differs between Solusi and ServiceNow after the upload
cardHint: Solusi and ServiceNow differ. First check that the Solusi file was uploaded; if it was, SACM sets the Solusi value itself.
cardText: First question: was this Solusi contract file uploaded to ServiceNow? If not, upload it, load a new ServiceNow contract report and look again. If it was, SACM sets the value of Solusi in ServiceNow itself and marks the line as fixed; no incident is raised. A person's name that differs is on Contracts to fix in ServiceNow.
